ruleDefinitions.name: Container Residence Discovery Via Proc Virtual FS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects potential container discovery via listing of certain kernel features in the "/proc" virtual filesystem

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("awk$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/cat$") OR process_path = RGX("grep$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/head$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/less$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/more$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/nl$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/tail$")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/proc\\/2\\/.*") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/proc\\/.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\/cgroup$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/sched$"))))
